{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check for any remaining issues
print("Shape after deduplication:", trial_df.shape)
print("Unique patients:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check if sex distribution is balanced across arms and severity
sex_by_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm'])
sex_by_severity = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])

# Check response rates by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Check if severity is confounding the sex effect
response_by_sex_severity = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean()

# Check if age and biomarker baseline differ by sex
sex_summary = trial_df.groupby('sex').agg(
    age_mean=('age', 'mean'),
    biomarker_baseline_mean=('biomarker_baseline', 'mean'),
    biomarker_final_mean=('biomarker_final', 'mean')
)

sex_by_arm, sex_by_severity, response_by_sex, response_by_sex_severity, sex_summary"}
